title: U.S. National Security Agency's Classified Network Disrupted During Patching Reportedly Prompted by AI-Assisted Security Research
summary: The U.S. National Security Agency reported degraded internal systems during maintenance. Staff lost access to its classified communications network and faced staggered arrivals. The U.S. director of national intelligence linked the disruption to patching vulnerabilities in PHP, which researchers reportedly investigated with AI assistance. The agency said mission-critical capabilities remained operational.
